{{Quote|When the Tendor Virus struck the entire Caldoni system and my vaccine cured millions, what did I receive in return? Not enough.|Jenna Zan Arbor|<ref name="Evil" />}}
The '''Caldoni system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point by [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment]]'' to [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]].</ref> an outbreak of the [[Death/Legends|lethal]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|230|Tendor virus}}</ref> [[Tendor Virus]] took place throughout the entire [[Star system/Legends|system]], affecting millions of people. Eventually,<ref name="Evil" /> the [[Human/Legends|human]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Jenna Zan Arbor]] developed a vaccine that cured the Caldoni system's population.<ref name="Evil" /> In 43 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> while conversing with the captured [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Zan Arbor recalled the outbreak in the Caldoni system, claiming that she did not receive a sufficient reward for her accomplishments at the time.<ref name="Evil" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Caldoni system was first mentioned in [[Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment|''The Evil Experiment'']], [[Jude Watson]]'s [[2001]] twelfth installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' young-reader novel series.<ref name="Evil" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
